understanding: Verify UART core in DATA_BUS_WIDTH_8 FIFO-only build as Wishbone responder for serial modem communication, starting with directed bring-up then random exploration with bus serial checks and end-to-end comparison. This run performs only interface and feature dependency analysis from task goals and interface IDs with no source documents supplied, so all relations stay ordering, sequence_extension reuse, or p_sequencer_config coordination without inventing behavior, and missing DOCUMENTED semantics are raised as questions.

tasks.title: Wishbone register access sequences
tasks.goal: Implement wishbone_bus register access sequences with DLAB-gated divisor children for directed and constrained-random reads and writes.
queries: Confirm address representation and DLAB gating for shared addresses before coding?

tasks.title: Serial traffic sequences
tasks.goal: Implement serial_data traffic driving SRX_PAD_I and observing STX_PAD_O across documented line formats with normal, break and idle children.
queries: Confirm source-supported frame formats and break-hold semantics for serial children?

tasks.title: Modem handshake sequences
tasks.goal: Implement modem_control handshake driving modem inputs and MCR controls including loopback entry with single and simultaneous toggles.
queries: Confirm modem pin list, inactive levels and loopback routing from sources?

tasks.title: Bring-up clock and reset
tasks.goal: Implement clock_gen, reset_seq and power_on_reset coordination with fixed period per test covering documented clock points and bring-up order.
queries: Confirm clock period strata and reset polarity and deassertion requirements?

tasks.title: UART configuration sweep
tasks.goal: Implement uart_config programming of LCR format, divisor latches with DLAB, FIFO trigger and IER enables in dependency order with sweep.

depends_on.reason: UART LCR divisor FIFO IER programming requires stable clock and completed reset bring-up before any register access.
Configuration sweep reuses Wishbone DLAB-gated divisor register read and write base sequences for directed and random programming.

queries: Confirm legal LCR, divisor, trigger and IER values and programming order?

tasks.title: Loopback staged traffic
tasks.goal: Implement loopback_traffic, normal and error virtual sequences for staged THR to Receiver Buffer transfers with internal return.

depends_on.reason: Staged THR to Receiver Buffer loopback transfers require LCR format divisor FIFO trigger and IER programming completed first.
Loopback virtual sequences coordinate Wishbone THR accesses through shared virtual sequencer handle.
Loopback virtual sequences coordinate serial SRX STX traffic through shared virtual sequencer handle.
Loopback entry needs MCR loopback control and modem handshake coordination through shared virtual sequencer handle.

queries: Confirm loopback payload path and FIFO-only expectations for directed stage?

tasks.title: Wishbone bus monitor
tasks.goal: Implement wishbone_bus monitor sampling handshake and reconstructing register read and write transactions for scoreboard and coverage.

depends_on.reason: Wishbone handshake sampling requires stable clock and reset deassertion order to avoid X sampling.

queries: Confirm bus handshake signals and acknowledge behavior for transaction reconstruction?

tasks.title: Serial data monitor
tasks.goal: Implement serial_data monitor sampling pads and reconstructing transmit and receive frame transactions without driving inputs.

depends_on.reason: Serial pad sampling requires stable clock and reset order to reconstruct frames.

queries: Confirm tx versus rx event direction and frame sampling for monitor only?

tasks.title: Modem interrupt baud observers
tasks.goal: Implement passive modem_control, uart_interrupt and baud_output observers with analysis ports for status and interrupt comparison.

depends_on.reason: Passive modem interrupt baud observers require stable clock and reset order before status comparison.

queries: Confirm modem, interrupt and baud observation ports and passive roles?

tasks.title: Reset FIFO and LCR checks
tasks.goal: Check receiver and transmitter FIFOs cleared on reset and LCR reset to 8 bits no parity 1 stop as review-gated checks.

depends_on.reason: FIFO cleared and LCR reset checks require completed power-on reset coordination.

queries: Provide verbatim source for FIFO clear and LCR reset values?

tasks.title: Reset divisor and known outputs
tasks.goal: Check Divisor Latch zero on reset and DUT outputs reaching known non-XZ after WB_RST_I deassertion.

depends_on.reason: Divisor zero and known non-XZ outputs require reset deassertion order.

queries: Provide source for divisor reset and known-after-reset requirement?

tasks.title: Normal modem traffic with errors
tasks.goal: Run normal traffic with concurrent THR writes, SRX frames and modem toggles plus parity, framing and break error injection and recovery.

depends_on.reason: Normal traffic with parity framing break injection requires configured line format divisor and enables before THR SRX and modem toggles.
Error traffic extends staged loopback normal virtual sequences with concurrent error injection children.

queries: Confirm error injection hooks and LSR recovery to clean traffic?

tasks.title: Overrun corner burst
tasks.goal: Drive Receiver FIFO fill bursts with overrun characters and varied pop timing and check LSR overrun reporting.

depends_on.reason: Overrun burst reuses staged THR to Receiver Buffer transfer sequences with varied pop timing.

queries: Confirm FIFO depth, full condition and overrun arrival semantics?

tasks.title: XZ protocol check
tasks.goal: Flag X or Z sampled on WISHBONE, serial and modem signals in monitors as protocol checks.

depends_on.reason: XZ protocol flagging on Wishbone signals requires bus monitor sampling established.
XZ protocol flagging on serial pads requires serial monitor sampling established.
XZ protocol flagging on modem signals requires passive modem observer sampling established.

queries: Confirm which control and data signals are covered by XZ checks?

tasks.title: IER reset checks
tasks.goal: Require IER all disabled after reset and bits 7-4 remain zero with explicit masks and null unknown reset.

depends_on.reason: IER disabled after reset check requires completed reset sequence before Wishbone read.

queries: Provide source for IER reset value and reserved bits behavior?

tasks.title: IER enable and IIR pending
tasks.goal: Require IER bits 0-3 to gate Received Data, THRE, Line Status and Modem Status interrupts and IIR bit0 pending polarity.

depends_on.reason: IER gating of Received Data THRE Line Status Modem Status and IIR pending polarity require IER programming first.

queries: Confirm interrupt source mapping and pending versus no-pending encoding?

tasks.title: IIR priority and fixed bits
tasks.goal: Require IIR bits 3-1 highest priority reporting with reset control and every read returning bits 7-6 as 1 and 5-4 as 0.

depends_on.reason: IIR highest-priority reporting and fixed bits check requires enabled interrupt sources settled first.

queries: Confirm IIR priority encoding and fixed compatibility bits source?

tasks.title: LSR parity framing checks
tasks.goal: Require LSR parity error and framing error indications for top-of-FIFO character with read-clear behavior.

depends_on.reason: LSR parity framing indications require configured line format before error injection and read-clear observation.

queries: Confirm parity and framing error latching and clear semantics?

tasks.title: LSR data-ready and coverage
tasks.goal: Require LSR data-ready when FIFO non-empty and cover data-ready, overrun, parity, framing, break and error-summary indications.

depends_on.reason: LSR data-ready overrun parity framing break coverage requires staged FIFO traffic with errors.

queries: Confirm data-ready empty versus non-empty and LSR coverage points?

tasks.title: Wishbone access coverage
tasks.goal: Cover WISHBONE slave accesses with direction and acknowledge plus DLAB gating of normal versus divisor at shared addresses.

depends_on.reason: Wishbone direction acknowledge and DLAB gating coverage requires base register access stimulus.
Wishbone access coverage sampling requires bus monitor reconstructed transactions.

queries: Confirm documented addresses and DLAB gating for coverage bins?

tasks.title: Divisor latch coverage
tasks.goal: Cover divisor zero, max and mid values with DLAB handling crossed with register access to prove gating.

depends_on.reason: Divisor zero max mid coverage crossed with access requires DLAB handling sweep programmed.

queries: Confirm divisor values and cross with DLAB configuration?

tasks.title: Interrupt identification coverage
tasks.goal: Cover interrupt pending and highest-priority type with source and reset plus fixed-bits property on every IIR read.

depends_on.reason: Interrupt pending and priority coverage requires passive interrupt observer transactions.

queries: Confirm IIR types and fixed-bits property activation?

tasks.title: Shared address direction coverage
tasks.goal: Cover shared-address direction mapping for receive versus transmit and identification versus control as review-gated register coverage.

depends_on.reason: Shared-address direction mapping coverage requires DLAB-gated normal versus divisor handling.

queries: Confirm shared-address direction decoding for coverage?

tasks.title: Cross interrupt traffic coverage
tasks.goal: Cross interrupt type with enable masking and cross RX-TX with line errors and modem activity for interaction handling.

depends_on.reason: Interrupt with RX-TX line-error modem cross requires staged interaction traffic first.

queries: Confirm masking and concurrent error plus modem interaction bins?

tasks.title: Clock period coverage
tasks.goal: Cover sampled CLK period-frequency band, boundary and stratum using observed edges with fixed period per test.

depends_on.reason: Clock period-frequency band stratum coverage requires fixed-period clock generation per test.

queries: Confirm clock bands and strata for sampling?
